<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Бот. Отправить файл" InternalName="TelegramBotSendFile" FriendlyName="Отправление файла в чат" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Telegram.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="20" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function TelegramBotSendFile{{{block_id}}}
{    
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
           
        $client    = {{{TConnection}}}; 
        $chatid    = {{{ChatId}}};  
        $messageid = {{{MessageId}}};
        $filename  = {{{FileName}}}; 
        $Caption   = {{{Caption}}};
        $DisableNotification   = ${{{DisableNotification}}};
        $DisableWebPagePreview = ${{{DisableWebPagePreview}}};
        $IsFormattingHtml      = ${{{IsFormattingHtml}}}; 
        $threadidobj           = {{{ThreadId}}};
        
        {AddTypesTelegram}
                
        $filename = ExpandConstFilePath $filename
                              
        if($null -eq $Caption) { $Caption = ""; }
        $Caption = $Caption.ToString();
        
        $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
        if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassBot"))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
            return;
        }  
        
        try
        {
            $client.DisableNotification = $DisableNotification;
            $client.DisableWebPagePreview = $DisableWebPagePreview;
            $client.IsFormattingHtml = $IsFormattingHtml; 
            $client.NumberAttempts        = {{{NumberAttempts}}};
        }
        catch {}
          
        if(-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($filename))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("ERRORCONST_PATHNOTFOUND: $filename");
            return;
        }
        
        $chatid    = _tostring($chatid);
        $messageid = _tostring($messageid); 
        $threadid = _tostring($threadidobj);
        
        $tlResult = $client.SendFile($chatid, $messageid, $filename, $Caption, $threadid); 
        if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;} 
        {{{TMessage}}} = $tlResult.Message;
    }
    catch 
    {     
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

function TelegramBotSendPhoto{{{block_id}}}
{    
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
           
        $client    = {{{TConnection}}}; 
        $chatid    = {{{ChatId}}};  
        $messageid = {{{MessageId}}};
        $filename  = {{{FileName}}}; 
        $Caption   = {{{Caption}}}; 
        $DisableNotification   = ${{{DisableNotification}}};
        $DisableWebPagePreview = ${{{DisableWebPagePreview}}};
        $IsFormattingHtml      = ${{{IsFormattingHtml}}}; 
        $threadidobj           = {{{ThreadId}}};
        
        {AddTypesTelegram}
            
        $filename = ExpandConstFilePath $filename
                        
        if($null -eq $Caption) { $Caption = ""; }
        $Caption = $Caption.ToString();
        
        $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
        if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassBot"))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
            return;
        } 
                  
        try
        {
            $client.DisableNotification = $DisableNotification;
            $client.DisableWebPagePreview = $DisableWebPagePreview;
            $client.IsFormattingHtml = $IsFormattingHtml;   
            $client.NumberAttempts        = {{{NumberAttempts}}};
        }
        catch {}
        
        if(-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($filename))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("ERRORCONST_PATHNOTFOUND: $filename");
            return;
        }
        
        $chatid    = _tostring($chatid);
        $messageid = _tostring($messageid);
        $threadid = _tostring($threadidobj);
        
        $tlResult = $client.SendPhoto($chatid, $messageid, $filename, $Caption, $threadid); 
        if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;} 
        {{{TMessage}}} = $tlResult.Message;
    }
    catch 
    {     
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Бот. Отправить сообщение" InternalName="TelegramBotSendText" FriendlyName="Отправление текстового сообщения в чат" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Telegram.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="30" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function TelegramBotSendText{{{block_id}}}
{    
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
           
        $client                 = {{{TConnection}}}; 
        $chatid                 = {{{ChatId}}};  
        $messageid              = {{{MessageId}}};
        $text                   = {{{Text}}}; 
        $Buttons                = {{{Buttons}}}; 
        $DisableNotification    = ${{{DisableNotification}}};
        $DisableWebPagePreview  = ${{{DisableWebPagePreview}}};
        $IsFormattingHtml       = ${{{IsFormattingHtml}}}; 
        $NumberButtonColumnsObj = {{{NumberButtonColumns}}};
        $threadidobj            = {{{ThreadId}}}; 
        
        {AddTypesTelegram}
             
        $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
        if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassBot"))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
            return;
        } 
        
        try
        {
            $client.DisableNotification   = $DisableNotification;
            $client.DisableWebPagePreview = $DisableWebPagePreview;
            $client.IsFormattingHtml      = $IsFormattingHtml;  
            $client.NumberAttempts        = {{{NumberAttempts}}};
        }
        catch {}
        
        $chatid              = _tostring($chatid);
        $messageid           = _tostring($messageid); 
        $NumberButtonColumns = _toint($NumberButtonColumnsObj);
        $threadid            = _tostring($threadidobj);         
        
        if('{{{Buttons}}}'.Length -gt 0 -and '{{{Buttons}}}' -ne '""')
        {
            $tlResult = $client.SendButton($chatid, $messageid, $text, $Buttons, $NumberButtonColumns, $threadid); 
            if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;}  
            {{{TMessage}}} = $tlResult.Message;
        }
        else
        {
            $tlResult = $client.SendText($chatid, $messageid, $text, $threadid); 
            if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;} 
            {{{TMessage}}} = $tlResult.Message;
        }        
    }
    catch 
    {     
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

Создать подключение" InternalName="TelegramClientCreate" FriendlyName="Создает подключение к Telegram в виде клиента" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Telegram.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="12" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function TelegramClientCreate{{{block_id}}}
{    
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
           
        $SessionName     = {{{SessionName}}};
        $TimeoutObj      = {{{Timeout}}};       
        $TimeoutFormObj  = {{{TimeoutForm}}};
        $EnableDebugMode = ${{{EnableDebugMode}}};
        
        {AddTypesTelegram}
        
        $client = [Telegram.ClassClient]::new(); 
    
        try { if($EnableDebugMode) { $client.LogLevel = 4; } } 
        catch {}     
        
        $Timeout = _toint($TimeoutObj); 
        $TimeoutForm = _toint($TimeoutFormObj);
        
        $tlResult = $client.CreateConnection($SessionName, $Timeout, $TimeoutForm);              
        if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;}

        {{{TConnection}}} = $client;    
    }
    catch 
    {     
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Клиент. Создать чат" InternalName="TelegramClientCreateChat" FriendlyName="Создает новый чат" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Telegram.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="7" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function TelegramClientCreateChat{{{block_id}}}
{    
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
           
        $client      = {{{TConnection}}}; 
        $Title      = {{{Title}}};
        $InviteUsers = {{{InviteUsers}}};    
        
        {AddTypesTelegram}
             
        $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
        if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassClient"))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
            return;
        } 
                
        $useimport = $true;
        
        $users = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[string];
                   
        if($null -eq $InviteUsers) { $InviteUsers = ""; }
        
        $vartype = $InviteUsers.GetType().Name;
        if($vartype.Contains("List") -or $vartype.Contains("[]"))
        {
            foreach($item in $InviteUsers)
            {                            
                $users.Add($item.ToString());
            } 
        } 
        else
        {       
            if(_isnotempty($InviteUsers))
            {
                $users.Add($InviteUsers.ToString());  
            }
        }             
        
        $tlResult = $client.CreateChat($users, $Title, 0); 
        if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;}  
        
        {{{ChatId}}} = $tlResult.RawResult;
    }
    catch 
    {     
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);

function TelegramClientCreateSuperGroupOrChanel{{{block_id}}}
{  
    try
    {
      $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}"); 
      $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");  
      
      $client   = {{{TConnection}}}; 
      $title    = {{{Title}}};
      $descript = {{{descript}}};
      $isChanel = ${{{isChanel}}};
      
      {AddTypesTelegram}  
  
       $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
       if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassClient"))
       {
          $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
          return;
       }   
     
      $tlResult = $client.CreateSuperGroupOrChanel($isChanel,$title,$descript,0)
       
       if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;}  
       
       {{{ChatId}}} = $tlResult.RawResult.ToString();
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_); 
        return;
    }                    
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Клиент. Скачать файл" InternalName="TelegramClientDownloadFile" FriendlyName="Скачивает файл из сообщения" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Telegram.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="5" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function TelegramClientDownloadFile{{{block_id}}}
{    
    try
    {
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
       
    $client   = {{{TConnection}}};
    $message  = {{{TMessage}}};
    $filename = {{{FileName}}};
        
        {AddTypesTelegram}
             
        $filename = ExpandConstFilePath $filename
        
        $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
        if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassClient"))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
            return;
        } 
        
        try
        {
            $client.NumberAttempts        = {{{NumberAttempts}}};
        } 
        catch {}
        
        $tlResult = $client.DownloadFile($message, $filename);
        if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;}
    }
    catch 
    {     
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

function TelegramClientGetChatId{{{block_id}}}
{    
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
           
        $client  = {{{TConnection}}}; 
        $target  = {{{Target}}};    
        
        {AddTypesTelegram}
             
        $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
        if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassClient"))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
            return;
        } 
                
        $useimport = $true;
        
        $target    = _tostring($target);
        
        $tlResult = $client.GetChatId($target); 
        if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;}  
        
        {{{ChatId}}} = $tlResult.Result;
    }
    catch 
    {     
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Клиент. Выгрузить сообщения" InternalName="TelegramClientGetMessages" FriendlyName="Выгружает сообщения из чата. Выгрузка сообщений происходит с последнего, т.е. снизу вверх" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Telegram.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="26" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function TelegramClientGetMessages{{{block_id}}}
{    
    try
    {
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
       
    $client         = {{{TConnection}}}; 
    $target         = {{{Target}}};    
    $offsetid       = {{{OffsetId}}};  
    $limit          = {{{Limit}}};
    $filtercontact  = {{{FilterContact}}};
    $filtertext     = {{{FilterText}}};  
    $filterthreadid = {{{FilterThreadId}}};
        
        {AddTypesTelegram}
             
        $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
        if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassClient"))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
            return;
        } 
        
        $target = $target.ToString();
        $filtercontact = $filtercontact.ToString();
        $filtertext = $filtertext.ToString();
                
        $offsetid_long = 0;
        [long]::TryParse([string]$offsetid, [ref]$offsetid_long); 
        
        $filterthreadid = _tostring($filterthreadid);
                        
        try
        {
            $client.NumberAttempts        = {{{NumberAttempts}}};
        } 
        catch {}
        
        $listmessages = $client.GetMessages($target, $offsetid_long, $limit, $filtercontact, $filtertext, $filterthreadid); 
        if($client.LastError.Length -gt 0)
        {
            $__Error.Exception($client.LastError);
            return;
        }
        if($null -eq $listmessages)
        {
            $__Error.Exception("No messages found");
            return;
        }
         
        {{{Messages}}} = $listmessages;
    }
    catch 
    {     
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

        $client = {{{TConnection}}}; 
        $IsWaitMessage = ${{{IsWaitMessage}}};
        
        {AddTypesTelegram}
             
        $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
        if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassClient"))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
            return;
        }
            
        while($true)
        {
            $message = $client.GetReceivedMessage();

                return;
            } 
            break;
        }

        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Клиент. Отправить голосовое сообщение" InternalName="TelegramClientSendVoice" FriendlyName="Отправляет голосовое сообщение в чат" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Telegram.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="8" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function TelegramClientSendVoice{{{block_id}}}
{    
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
           
        $client                = {{{TConnection}}}; 
        $target                = {{{Target}}};  
        $replyidobj               = {{{ReplyId}}}; 
        $threadidobj              = {{{ThreadId}}};
        $filename              = {{{FileName}}}; 
        $caption               = {{{Caption}}};  
        $DisableNotification   = ${{{DisableNotification}}};
        $DisableWebPagePreview = ${{{DisableWebPagePreview}}};
        $IsFormattingHtml      = ${{{IsFormattingHtml}}};
        
        {AddTypesTelegram}
                   
        $filename = ExpandConstFilePath $filename
        
        $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
        if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassClient"))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
            return;
        } 
        
        try
        {
            $client.DisableNotification = $DisableNotification;
            $client.DisableWebPagePreview = $DisableWebPagePreview;
            $client.IsFormattingHtml = $IsFormattingHtml;   
            $client.NumberAttempts        = {{{NumberAttempts}}};
        }
        catch {}
          
        if(-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($filename))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("ERRORCONST_PATHNOTFOUND: $filename");
            return;
        }   
        
        $useimport = $true;
        
        $target   = _tostring($target);
        $replyid  = _tostring($replyidobj); 
        $threadid = _tostring($threadidobj);
        $caption  = _tostring($caption);
        
        $tlResult = $client.SendVoice($target, $useimport, $replyid, $threadid, $filename, $caption); 
        if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;}  
        
        {{{TMessage}}} = $tlResult.Message;
    }
    catch 
    {     
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

function TelegramGetMessageThreadId{{{block_id}}}
{    
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
           
        $client    = {{{TConnection}}}; 
        $target    = {{{Target}}};    
        $messageid = {{{MessageId}}};
    
        {AddTypesTelegram}
             
        $vartype = $client.GetType().Name;
        if(-not $vartype.Contains("ClassClient"))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("Connection is not Telegram");
            return;
        } 
                
        $target    = _tostring($target);
        $messageid = _tostring($messageid);
                      
        try
        {
            $client.NumberAttempts        = {{{NumberAttempts}}};
        } 
        catch {}
        
        $tlResult = $client.GetMessageThread($target, $messageid); 
        if($tlResult.IsError) { $__Error.Exception($tlResult.ErrorMessage); return;} 
        
        {{{ResultTarget}}} = $tlResult.Result;
        {{{ResultThreadId}}} = $tlResult.Result2; 
    }
    catch 
    {     
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

Для работы используется протокол EHLLAPI" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Terminal.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="16" LinuxAvailable="false" Code="
function TerminalConnectSession{{{block_id}}}
{    
	try
	{
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}"); 
       
    $SessionID = {{{SessionID}}};
    $PathDLL   = {{{PathDLL}}};
  
        {AddTypesTerminal}
               
        try       
        {
            {{{Connection}}}.Disconnect(); 
            {{{Connection}}}.Dispose();
            {{{Connection}}} = $null;
        }
        catch {}
        
        $terminal   = [TerminalHelpers.ClassMain]::new($PathDLL);
        $resultinit = $terminal.Initialize();
        if($resultinit.IsError) {$__Error.Exception($resultinit.ToString()); return;} 
                        
        $result = $terminal.Connect($SessionID);
        if($result.IsError) {$__Error.Exception($result.ToString()); return;} 
        
        {{{Connection}}} = $terminal;    
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

function ToJson{{{block_id}}}
{
    try
    {
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
           
    $InObject = {{{InObject}}}; 
    $NumDepth = {{{NumDepth}}}; 
    $AlternateMethod = ${{{AlternateMethod}}}; 
    
        if($AlternateMethod)
        {
            {{{Result}}} = [Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert]::SerializeObject($InObject, [Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting]::Indented);
        }
        else
        {
            $_depth = 2;
            [int]::TryParse($NumDepth, [ref] $_depth);
            
            {{{Result}}} = ConvertTo-Json $InObject -Depth $_depth    
        }
    }
    catch 
    {
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Преобразовать строку" InternalName="TransformString" FriendlyName="Преобразовывает строку в заданный формат" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Texts.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="62" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function TransformString{{{block_id}}}
{
    try
    {
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}"); 
    
    $InString = {{{InString}}};
    $ThisType = "{{{ThisType}}}";
        
        $result = "";
            
        $InString = [string]$InString;  
        
        $isdot = $false;
        
        if($ThisType.Length -eq 0) { $ThisType = "Double"; }
        
        if($ThisType -eq "Int")
        {
            for($i = 0; $i -lt $InString.Length; $i++)
            {     
                $cc = $InString[$i];
                if([char]::IsDigit($cc) -or $cc -eq "-")
                {
                    $result+=$cc;
                }
            }    
            if($result.Length -eq 0)
            {
                $__Error.Exception("No numbers found in the string");
                return;
            }
            {{{Result}}} = [int]$result; 
        }
        elseif($ThisType -eq "Float" -or $ThisType -eq "Double")
        {
            for($i = 0; $i -lt $InString.Length; $i++)
            {
                $cc = $InString[$i];
                if([char]::IsDigit($cc) -or $cc -eq "-")
                {                       
                    $result+=$cc;
                }
                elseif($cc -eq "." -or $cc -eq ",")
                {       
                    if($isdot) { $result = $result.Replace(".", ""); }
                    $result+="."; 
                    $isdot = $true;
                }
            }     
            if($result.Length -eq 0)
            {
                $__Error.Exception("No numbers found in the string");
                return;
            }
            {{{Result}}} = [double]$result; 
        } 
        elseif($ThisType -eq "Money")
        {
            for($i = 0; $i -lt $InString.Length; $i++)
            {
                $cc = $InString[$i];
                if([char]::IsDigit($cc) -or $cc -eq "-")
                {
                    $result+=$cc;
                }
                elseif($cc -eq "." -or $cc -eq ",")
                {        
                    if($isdot) { $result = $result.Replace(".", ""); }
                    $result+=".";
                    $isdot = $true;
                }
            }     
            if($result.Length -eq 0)
            {
                $__Error.Exception("No numbers found in the string");
                return;
            }
            {{{Result}}} = [decimal]$result; 
        }
        elseif($ThisType -eq "LetterOrDigit")
        {
            for($i = 0; $i -lt $InString.Length; $i++)
            {
                $cc = $InString[$i];
                if([char]::IsLetterOrDigit($cc))
                {
                    $result+=$cc;
                }
            } 
            {{{Result}}} = $result;
        } 
        elseif($ThisType -eq "Letter")
        {
            for($i = 0; $i -lt $InString.Length; $i++)
            {
                $cc = $InString[$i];
                if([char]::IsLetter($cc))
                {
                    $result+=$cc;
                }
            } 
            {{{Result}}} = $result;
        } 
        elseif($ThisType -eq "Digit")
        {
            for($i = 0; $i -lt $InString.Length; $i++)
            {
                $cc = $InString[$i];
                if([char]::IsDigit($cc))
                {
                    $result+=$cc;
                }
            } 
            {{{Result}}} = $result;
        }
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
    $__Error.Quit();
}

TransposeDataTable.content:
<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Транспонирование" InternalName="TransposeDataTable" FriendlyName="Транспонирование таблицы данных. Переставляет строки и столбцы в заданной таблице" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Data table.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="14" LinuxAvailable="True" Code="
function TransposeDataTable{{{block_id}}}
{    
 try
 {
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}"); 
           
    $inputTable = {{{Table}}};
    
        $outputTable = New-Object System.Data.DataTable;

        $outputTable.Columns.Add($inputTable.Columns[0].ColumnName.ToString());

        foreach ($inRow in $inputTable.Rows)
        {
            $newColName = $inRow[0].ToString(); 
            if([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($newColName)){ $newColName = "Column";}
            $ind        = 1;
            while($outputTable.Columns.Contains($newColName))
            {
                $newColName += $ind.ToString(); 
                $ind++;
            }
            $outputTable.Columns.Add($newColName);
        }

        for ($rCount = 1; $rCount -le $inputTable.Columns.Count - 1; $rCount++)
        {
            $newRow = $outputTable.NewRow();

            $newRow[0] = $inputTable.Columns[$rCount].ColumnName.ToString();
            for ($cCount = 0; $cCount -le $inputTable.Rows.Count - 1; $cCount++)
            {
                $colValue = $inputTable.Rows[$cCount][$rCount];
                if($null -eq $colValue) { $colValue = ""; }
                $newRow[$cCount + 1] = $colValue.ToString();
            }
            $outputTable.Rows.Add($newRow);
        }  
        
        {{{Result}}} = $outputTable;
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }  
    $__Error.Quit();
}

Для правильной работы блоки этого контейнера должны заканчиваться блоком "Конец". При возникновении ошибки в блоках будет реализован выход по коннектору "Если ошибка". В противном случае по коннектору "Выход". Для имитации конструкции Finally требуется ручное соединение блоков после обработки ошибки с блоками коннектора "Выход". Если к коннектору "Если ошибка" не подключен блок, то ошибка будет игнорироваться, и выход будет произведен по коннектору "Выход". function TryCatchContainer{{{block_id}}}
{   
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","Default","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}"); 
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connector-Out}}}", "{{{connector-Out}}}"); 
                            
    try
    {
        $script:__LastBlockID = "{{{block_native_id}}}";
             
        $currentblockid = "{{{block_native_id}}}"; 
        
        $NumberAttemptsObj       = {{{NumberAttempts}}};  
        $PauseBetweenAttemptsObj = {{{PauseBetweenAttempts}}};    
        $ReportLevel             = "{{{ReportLevel}}}";

        try
        {         
            {{{Variable1}}} = {{{Expression1}}};
        }
        catch { if($__Error.CheckException($_.Exception.Message)) {return;} }

        try
        {         
            {{{Variable2}}} = {{{Expression2}}};
        }
        catch { if($__Error.CheckException($_.Exception.Message)) {return;} }

        try
        {         
            {{{Variable3}}} = {{{Expression3}}};
        }
        catch { if($__Error.CheckException($_.Exception.Message)) {return;} }

        try
        {         
            {{{Variable4}}} = {{{Expression4}}};
        }
        catch { if($__Error.CheckException($_.Exception.Message)) {return;} }

        try
        {         
            {{{Variable5}}} = {{{Expression5}}};
        }
        catch { if($__Error.CheckException($_.Exception.Message)) {return;} }

        try
        {         
            {{{Expression6}}}
        }
        catch { if($__Error.CheckException($_.Exception.Message)) {return;} }
        try
        {         
            {{{Expression7}}}
        }
        catch { if($__Error.CheckException($_.Exception.Message)) {return;} }
        try
        {         
            {{{Expression8}}}
        }
        catch { if($__Error.CheckException($_.Exception.Message)) {return;} }
        try
        {         
            {{{Expression9}}}
        }
        catch { if($__Error.CheckException($_.Exception.Message)) {return;} }
        try
        {         
            {{{Expression10}}}
        }
        catch { if($__Error.CheckException($_.Exception.Message)) {return;} }
        
    }
    catch {}
    
    $_NumberAttempts       = _toint($NumberAttemptsObj);
    $_PauseBetweenAttempts = _toint($PauseBetweenAttemptsObj);
    
    if($_NumberAttempts -le 0) { $_NumberAttempts = 1; }
           
    if($script:__FuncIndex -gt $script:__LastFuncIndex) 
    { 
        $script:__IndexAttempt{{{block_id}}} = 0; 
    } 
    
    $script:__IndexAttempt{{{block_id}}} = $script:__IndexAttempt{{{block_id}}} + 1; 
    $script:__IndexAttempt = $script:__IndexAttempt{{{block_id}}}; 
           
    if($script:__IndexAttempt{{{block_id}}} -gt 1)
    {
        if($_PauseBetweenAttempts -gt 0) { [System.Threading.Thread]::Sleep($_PauseBetweenAttempts * 1000); }
    }
    
    if($_NumberAttempts -gt 1)
    {              
        if($ReportLevel -ne "Release")
        { 
            $val = "Попытка " + $script:__IndexAttempt{{{block_id}}}; 
            Write-Host("<info><ID>{{{block_native_id}}}</ID><InternalName>ErrorBlockLight</InternalName><InternalValue>$val</InternalValue></info>");
        }
    }
    
    $interceptConnectorError = ""; 
    $interceptConnectorNext = "";
    if ($script:__callstack.Count -gt 0)
    {
        $tempitem                = $script:__callstack.Peek();
        $interceptConnectorError = [string]$tempitem.ConnectorError;
        $interceptConnectorNext  = [string]$tempitem.ConnectorNext;
    }  
    
    $stackitem                  = [MainHelpers.StackItem]::new();
    $stackitem.ProcessContainer = "TryCatchContainer{{{block_id}}}";
    $stackitem.ConnectorNext    = "{{{connector-Out}}}"; 
    $stackitem.ConnectorError   = "{{{connector-Error}}}"; 
    
    if ($stackitem.ConnectorError.Length -eq 0) { $stackitem.ConnectorError = $stackitem.ConnectorNext; }
    if ($stackitem.ConnectorError.Length -eq 0) { $stackitem.ConnectorError = $interceptConnectorError; }
    if ($stackitem.ConnectorError.Length -eq 0) { $stackitem.ConnectorError = $interceptConnectorNext; } 
          
    if($script:__IndexAttempt{{{block_id}}} -lt $_NumberAttempts)
    {
        $stackitem.ConnectorError = $stackitem.ProcessContainer;
    }
        
    $script:__callstack.push($stackitem);  
    
    if($null -eq $script:__ProcessContainerErrorMessage)
    {
        $script:__ProcessContainerErrorMessage = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary[[string],[string]]'
    }

    $script:__ProcessContainerErrorMessage[$stackitem.ProcessContainer] = "{{{ErrorMessage}}}";
    
    $script:__NextBlockID = "{{{connector-Next}}}";  
}

UploadFTPFile.content:
<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Загрузить файл" InternalName="UploadFTPFile" FriendlyName="Загрузить файл на FTP/SFTP - сервер" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_FTP.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="38" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="function UploadFTPFile{{{block_id}}}
{             
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
    
        $FTPUrl         = {{{URL}}};
        $FTPUsername    = {{{Username}}};
        $FTPPasswordObj = {{{Password}}}; 
        $LocalFile       = {{{LocalFile}}}; 
        $PrivateKey     = {{{PrivateKey}}};
        
        $PrivateKey = ExpandConstFilePath $PrivateKey
     
        $LocalFile = ExpandConstFilePath $LocalFile
    
        $FTPPassword     = _checkpassword($FTPPasswordObj);
        $FTPUsername_str = _tostring($FTPUsername);
        $FTPPassword_str = _tostring($FTPPassword);  
        
        $client          = [MainHelpers.ClassFTP]::new();
        $client.Url      = $FTPUrl;
        $client.Username = $FTPUsername_str;
        $client.Password = $FTPPassword_str;   
        $client.PrivateKey = $PrivateKey;
                
        $client.UploadFTPFile($LocalFile);
        if($client.IsError)
        {
            $__Error.Exception($client.ErrorMessage);
            return;
        }
    }
    catch
    {
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }    
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Загрузить папку" InternalName="UploadFTPFolder" FriendlyName="Загрузить папку на FTP/SFTP - сервер" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_FTP.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="37" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="function UploadFTPFolder{{{block_id}}}
{                              
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
    
        $FTPUrl         = {{{URL}}};
        $FTPUsername    = {{{Username}}};
        $FTPPasswordObj = {{{Password}}}; 
        $LocalFolder       = {{{LocalFolder}}}; 
        $PrivateKey     = {{{PrivateKey}}};
        
        $PrivateKey = ExpandConstFilePath $PrivateKey
     
        $LocalFolder = ExpandConstFilePath $LocalFolder
    
        $FTPPassword     = _checkpassword($FTPPasswordObj);
        $FTPUsername_str = _tostring($FTPUsername);
        $FTPPassword_str = _tostring($FTPPassword); 
        
        
        $client          = [MainHelpers.ClassFTP]::new();
        $client.Url      = $FTPUrl;
        $client.Username = $FTPUsername_str;
        $client.Password = $FTPPassword_str;  
        $client.PrivateKey = $PrivateKey;
                
        $client.UploadFTPFolder($LocalFolder);
        if($client.IsError)
        {
            $__Error.Exception($client.ErrorMessage);
            return;
        }
    }
    catch
    {
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
    $__Error.Quit();
}

function UploadingFileToS3{{{block_id}}}
{                
    try

    }
    catch

        return;
    }                    
    $__Error.Quit();
}

function ValidateJsonSchema{{{block_id}}}
{
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
                         
        $JsonSchema = {{{JsonSchema}}}; 
        $JsonString = {{{JsonString}}};
                
        $valid = [MainHelpers.ClassJsonSchema]::Validate($JsonSchema, $JsonString); 
        
        if($valid)
        {
            $__Error.Jump("{{{connector-Yes}}}");
            return;
        }
        else
        {
            $__Error.Jump("{{{connector-No}}}");
            return;
        }
   
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
    $__Error.Quit();
}

function ViewingFoldersAndFilesS3{{{block_id}}}
{                
    try
    {               
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");

            $Connector    = {{{Connector}}};

            }

           {{{Result}}}  =  $S3Result.Value
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_); 
        return;
    }                    
    $__Error.Quit();
}

WaitFile.content:
<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Ожидать файл" InternalName="WaitFile" FriendlyName="Ожидает появление файла заданное время. Если файл за указанное время не будет обнаружен в папке, то сгенерируется ошибка" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_Files_Folders.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="6" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function WaitFile{{{block_id}}}
{         
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}"); 
              
        $DirectoryPath = {{{DirectoryPath}}}; 
        $FileName      = {{{FileName}}}; 
        $WaitTimeStr   = {{{WaitTime}}};
    
        $DirectoryPath = ExpandConstFilePath $DirectoryPath
        
        $_waittime = _toint($WaitTimeStr); 
                  
        if($null -eq $FileName) { $FileName = ""; }
        
        $listfilename = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[string];  
        $vartype = $FileName.GetType().Name;
        if($vartype.Contains("List") -or $vartype.Contains("[]"))
        {        
            foreach($s in $FileName)
            {       
                $_str = $s.ToString();
                if($_str.Length -gt 0) { $listfilename.Add($_str); }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            $_str = $FileName.ToString(); 
            if($_str.Length -gt 0) { $listfilename.Add($_str); }
        }
        
        $stopwatch = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();
        while($true)
        {        
            $yeswait = $false;
            foreach($itemfilename in $listfilename)
            {
                $list = [System.IO.Directory]::GetFiles($DirectoryPath, $itemfilename); 
                if($list.Length -gt 0)
                {       
                    $yeswait = $true;
                    {{{Result}}} = $list[0];
                    break;
                }
            }
           
            if($yeswait) { break; } 
            
            [System.Threading.Thread]::Sleep(1000);
            if($stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds -ge $_waittime) 
            {     
                $stopwatch.Stop();
                $__Error.Exception("File Timeout Waiting error");
                return;
            } 
        }
        $stopwatch.Stop();
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Цикл Пока" InternalName="While" FriendlyName="Цикл позволяет повторить цепочку действий (блоков) несколько раз, пока выполняется условие, заданное в виде выражения. При каждом входе в блок проверяется выражение, указанное в свойстве Условие, и если оно истинно, то выполнение сценария продолжится в сторону выхода Условие данного блока (в так называемое "тело цикла"). Как только при очередном проходе через данный блок Условие перестало выполняться, сценарий продолжится в сторону нижнего выхода блока. Не забудьте соединить выход последнего блока в теле цикла со входом данного блока или какого-либо из предшествующих блоков." Width="100" Height="100" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\icotb_While simple.png" PathToToolboxImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\icotb_While.png" ImageType="TopImageDockSmall" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="32" LinuxAvailable="True" Code="
function While{{{block_id}}}
{     
    try
    {
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}"); 
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");  
    
    $Condition = {{{Condition}}}
    
        if ($Condition)
        {                          
            $__Error.Jump("{{{connector-Iteration}}}");
            return;
        } 
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_); 
        return;
    }
    $__Error.Quit();
}

Максимальный размер файла - 25 МБ" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\icon_chatgpt.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="10" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function WhisperRecognizeSpeech{{{block_id}}}
{
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
        
        $AudioFile      = {{{AudioFile}}};
        $Model          = "{{{Model}}}";
        $Language       = {{{Language}}};
        $Prompt         = {{{Prompt}}};
        $TemperatureObj = {{{Temperature}}};
        $TimeoutObj     = {{{Timeout}}};
      
        $AudioFile = ExpandConstFilePath $AudioFile  
        
        if(-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($AudioFile))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("ERRORCONST_PATHNOTFOUND: $AudioFile");
            return;
        }
                      
        if(!$script:__OpenAI)
        {
            $script:__OpenAI = [MainHelpers.ClassOpenAI]::new();
        }  
                     
        $psResult = $script:__OpenAI.AudioTranscriptions($AudioFile, $Model, $Language, $Prompt, $TemperatureObj, $TimeoutObj); 
        if($__Error.CheckResult($psResult)) { return; }

        {{{Result}}} = $psResult.Result;
        
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Синтезировать речь (Whisper)" InternalName="WhisperSynthesizeSpeech" FriendlyName="Синтезирует речь из указанного текста. Поддерживаемый формат: mp3" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\icon_chatgpt.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="12" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function WhisperSynthesizeSpeech{{{block_id}}}
{
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
        
        $Text       = {{{Text}}};
        $Model      = "{{{Model}}}";  
        $Voice      = "{{{Voice}}}";
        $TargetFile = {{{TargetFile}}}; 
        $TimeoutObj = {{{Timeout}}};  
        $SpeedObj   = {{{Speed}}};
      
           
        if([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($TargetFile)) 
        {     
            $tempname = [System.IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName();                                           
            $tempfile = [System.IO.Path]::Combine($__WorkPath, $tempname);
            $TargetFile = [System.IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($tempfile, ".mp3");
        }
        
        $TargetFile = ExpandConstFilePath $TargetFile
                      
        if(!$script:__OpenAI)
        {
            $script:__OpenAI = [MainHelpers.ClassOpenAI]::new();
        } 
             
        $psResult = $script:__OpenAI.AudioSpeech($Text, $Model, $Voice, $SpeedObj, $TimeoutObj); 
        if($__Error.CheckResult($psResult)) { return; }
        
        if([System.IO.File]::Exists($TargetFile))
        {
            [System.IO.File]::Delete($TargetFile);
        }
        
        [System.IO.File]::Move($psResult.Result, $TargetFile);
                
        {{{ResultFile}}} = $TargetFile;
        
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

function WriteValueToRegistry{{{block_id}}}
{                    
	try
	{
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}"); 
       
    $Root  = "{{{ROOT}}}";
    $Key   = {{{Key}}};
    $Name  = {{{Name}}}; 
    $Value = {{{Value}}};

        if($Root -eq "HKEY_CURRENT_USER") { $mainkey = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::CurrentUser; }
        if($Root -eq "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT") { $mainkey = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::ClassesRoot; }
        if($Root -eq "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG") { $mainkey = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::CurrentConfig; }
        if($Root -eq "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE") { $mainkey = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::LocalMachine; }
        if($Root -eq "HKEY_PERFORMANCE_DATA") { $mainkey = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::PerformanceData; }
        if($Root -eq "HKEY_USERS") { $mainkey = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::Users; }  

        $regkey = $mainkey.OpenSubKey($Key, $true);
        $regkey.SetValue($Name, $Value); 
        $regkey.Close();
    }   
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    } 
    $__Error.Quit();
}

С его помощью вы можете создавать новые тексты по запросу, выполнять разнообразные задачи классификации, суммаризации, перевода и рерайтинга текстов, написание прототипов кода на разных языках программирования, парсить полуструктурированные и неструктурированные данные, извлекать и обрабатывать факты, поддерживать диалог на разнообразные темы, и многое другое. Оплата за использование данного функционала списывается с лицевого счета клиента на платформе. Для тестовых целей каждому новому пользователю даётся возможность протестировать данный функционал без оплаты. При использовании данного функционала после окончания разработки робота необходима оплата." function YandexGPTRequest{{{block_id}}}
{        
    try

        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
        
        $InTable         = {{{InTable}}}; 
        $ContentSystem   = {{{ContentSystem}}};
        $ContentUser     = {{{ContentUser}}};
        $Model           = "{{{Model}}}";  
        $TemperatureObj  = {{{Temperature}}}; 
        $MaxLengthObj    = {{{MaxLength}}};  
        $AutoLengthLimit = ${{{AutoLengthLimit}}};
        $TimeoutObj      = {{{Timeout}}};      
        
        if(!$script:__YandexGPT)
        {
            $script:__YandexGPT = [MainHelpers.ClassYandexGPT]::new();
        }
                       
        $psResult = $script:__YandexGPT.ChatCompletions($InTable, $null, $null, $ContentSystem, $ContentUser, $Model, $null, $TemperatureObj, $MaxLengthObj, $AutoLengthLimit, $TimeoutObj);
        if($__Error.CheckResult($psResult)) { return; }               
                    
        {{{ResponseRole}}} = $psResult.Result;
        {{{ResponseContent}}} = $psResult.Result2;
        {{{TotalTokens}}} = _toint($psResult.Result3);  
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }                  
    $__Error.Quit();
}

function YandexRecognizeSpeech{{{block_id}}}
{
    try
    {
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
    
    $AudioFile       = {{{AudioFile}}};
    $Lang  = "{{{Lang}}}"; 
    
      
        $AudioFile = ExpandConstFilePath $AudioFile  
        
        if(-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($AudioFile))
        {
            $__Error.Exception("ERRORCONST_PATHNOTFOUND: $AudioFile");
            return;
        }
                      
        if(!$script:__YandexSpeechKit) { $script:__YandexSpeechKit = [BusinessMethods.ClassYandexSpeechKit]::new(); }  
                     
        $psResult = $script:__YandexSpeechKit.RecognizeSpeech($AudioFile, $Lang); 
        if($__Error.CheckResult($psResult)) { return; }

        {{{Result}}} = $psResult.Result;
        
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Синтезировать речь (Yandex)" InternalName="YandexSynthesizeSpeech" FriendlyName="Синтезирует речь из указанного текста. Поддерживаемые форматы: mp3; ogg; wav" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\icon_chatgpt.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="1" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function YandexSynthesizeSpeech{{{block_id}}}
{
    try
    {
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
    
    $Text       = {{{Text}}};
    $LangVoice  = "{{{LangVoice}}}"; 
    $TargetFile = {{{TargetFile}}}; 
      
           
        if([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($TargetFile)) 
        {     
            $tempname = [System.IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName();                                           
            $tempfile = [System.IO.Path]::Combine($__WorkPath, $tempname);
            $TargetFile = [System.IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($tempfile, ".mp3");
        }
        
        $TargetFile = ExpandConstFilePath $TargetFile
                      
        if(!$script:__YandexSpeechKit) { $script:__YandexSpeechKit = [BusinessMethods.ClassYandexSpeechKit]::new(); }  
             
        $strarr = $LangVoice.Split(":");
        
        $psResult = $script:__YandexSpeechKit.SynthesizeSpeech($Text, $strarr[1], $strarr[0], $TargetFile); 
        if($__Error.CheckResult($psResult)) { return; }

        {{{ResultFile}}} = $psResult.Result;
        
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Yandex Переводчик" InternalName="YandexTranslate" FriendlyName="Yandex Переводчик" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\icon_Translate.png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="33" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function YandexTranslate{{{block_id}}}
{
	try
	{
    $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
    $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
    
    $InData         = {{{InData}}};
    $SourceLanguage = "{{{SourceLanguage}}}"; 
    $TargetLanguage = "{{{TargetLanguage}}}"; 
      
        
        $InDataType = $InData.GetType().Name;
        
        $texts = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[string];
        if($InDataType.Contains("List") -or $InDataType.Contains("[]"))
        {
            foreach($s in $InData) { $texts.Add($s.ToString()); }
        }
        else 
        {
            $texts.Add($InData.ToString());
        }
        
        if(!$script:__YandexTranslate) { $script:__YandexTranslate = [BusinessMethods.ClassYandexTranslate]::new(); }  
        
        $resultdata = $script:__YandexTranslate.Processed($texts, $SourceLanguage, $TargetLanguage);
        if(!$resultdata)
        {
            $__Error.Exception("ERRORCONST_ERRORYANDEXTRANSLATE");
            return;
        } 
        
        if($InDataType.Contains("List") -or $InDataType.Contains("[]"))
        {              
            {{{Result}}} = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[string];
            foreach($s in $resultdata) { {{{Result}}}.Add($s); }
        }
        else 
        {
            {{{Result}}} = $resultdata[0];
        }
        
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }
                        
    $__Error.Quit();
}

<ToolboxItemSettings DisplayName="Yandex Vision OCR" InternalName="YandexVisionOCR" FriendlyName="Распознавание Yandex Vision OCR" Width="200" Height="75" PathToImage="ExternalToolboxes\Image\ico_OCR Recognize Document .png" PathToToolboxImage="{x:Null}" ImageType="LeftImage" NoDelete="False" Invisible="False" Proportional="True" Version="20" LinuxAvailable="true" Code="
function YandexVisionOCR{{{block_id}}}
{
    try
    {
        $__Error.Enter("{{{block_native_id}}}", "{{{ErrorLevel}}}","{{{ErrorDirection}}}","{{{ReportLevel}}}","{{{ErrorMessage}}}");
        $__Error.AddConnectors("{{{connector-Error}}}", "{{{connectorRight}}}", "{{{connectorBottom}}}");
           
        $FileName      = {{{FileName}}};  
        $PageIndex_str = {{{PageIndex}}}; 
        $Model         = "{{{Model}}}";
        $Languages     = "{{{Languages}}}";
        
        $FileName = ExpandConstFilePath $FileName
             
            
        if($null -eq $PageIndexObj) { $PageIndexObj = ""; }
        
        $cls = [OCRModules.ClassYandexVisionOCR]::new($Model);
                        
        $PageIndex = _tostring($PageIndex_str);  
        
        $psResult = $cls.Processed($FileName, $PageIndex, $Languages, $Model); 
        if($__Error.CheckResult($psResult)) { return; }
              
        {{{Result}}} = $psResult.RawResult; 
     
        $cls.Dispose();   
    }
    catch 
    { 
        $__Error.ExceptionCatch($_);
        return;
    }    
    $__Error.Quit();                     
}
